# McGowan Program Administrators

> Specialized insurance program administrator offering workplace violence, active shooter, restaurant, hospitality, real estate, and community association coverage solutions with integrated risk management services.

McGowan Program Administrators provides comprehensive insurance programs and risk management expertise across multiple industries. The company partners with organizations like Firestorm Crisis Management Solutions and leverages insights from industry experts including Karl Seebacher and Tim Lee to deliver specialized coverage for emerging risks including workplace violence, cyber threats, and industry-specific liabilities.

## Key Topics

- Active Shooter Insurance
- Workplace Violence Coverage
- Risk Management
- Business Insurance
- Restaurant & Hospitality Risks
- Real Estate E&O
- Community Associations (HOA)
- Third-Party Liability
- Cybersecurity
- Food Safety
- Professional Liability
- Crisis Management
- OSHA Compliance
- Insurance Policy Evaluation
